component.name: PhotosCrypto
component.summary: Hide and encrypt files inside plain symbol text

description.p: PhotosCrypto encrypts a file with your own password (scrypt + AES-256-GCM) and stores it as plain text made of a private symbol alphabet. The original name and format are kept inside the encrypted data and restored when decoding. An optional self-destruct mode deletes the file after a number of wrong passwords that you choose when encoding.
Added automatic zlib payload compression and optional password protection.
